assumptions: API amounts are hypothetical Standard token costs for the recorded usage, not actual invoices for these ChatGPT-authenticated Codex runs.
Codex amounts are Standard token-rate credit equivalents, not observed debit of included usage or purchased credits.
Ordinary-context pricing is assumed. A turn total is not necessarily one API request; request-level >272K pricing is not inferred from cumulative turn totals.
Reasoning output is included in output tokens; cached reads and cache writes are subsets of input tokens, not additional tokens.
Credit purchase prices depend on plan/agreement. usdPerCredit remains null unless explicitly supplied from a purchase quote.
Tool charges, subscriptions, taxes, discounts, development work, and human setup are excluded.

notes: Codex cache-write credit rate is not separately listed; zero observed cache writes need no rate assumption.
API Fast costs 2x applicable rates; Codex Fast costs 2.5x Standard credits. Neither multiplier is silently applied.
Codex cache-write credit rate is not separately listed; zero observed cache writes need no rate assumption.

apiLongContext.scope: per request, not cumulative CLI turn
